sourceAdmissionBoundary.note: W4 rules govern composition. They do not silently upgrade R6 source records into customer wording or Runtime Owner authority.

compositionModel.formula: Gate Base + Line Modifier + Driver Role + Personality/Design Role -> governed tag evidence -> Semantic Tags

statement.en: A compositional reading requires Gate Base, Line Modifier, Driver Role and Personality/Design Layer to be present. Missing any required factor returns UNKNOWN for compositional tags.
statement.zh-Hans: 组合读取必须同时具有 Gate Base、Line Modifier、Driver Role 与 Personality/Design Layer；任何必需因子缺失时，组合标签结果必须为 UNKNOWN。

statement.en: Gate Base is the semantic anchor. Line, Driver and Layer may modify emphasis, mode or visibility but may not replace the Gate Base with an unrelated meaning.
statement.zh-Hans: Gate Base 是语义锚点。Line、Driver 与 Layer 可以调节重点、方式或可见性，但不能用无关意义取代 Gate Base。

statement.en: Line modifies how a Gate meaning is expressed or operated. A Line number alone cannot create a semantic tag, topic, Runtime Owner or personal conclusion.
statement.zh-Hans: Line 只调节 Gate 意义如何表达或运行。单独的爻位数字不能产生 semantic tag、topic、Runtime Owner 或个人结论。

statement.en: Driver Role may change which function of the Gate meaning is emphasized, but a Driver identity or same-named role cannot automatically emit a same-named semantic tag.
statement.zh-Hans: Driver Role 可以改变 Gate 意义中哪一种运行功能被强调，但 Driver 身份或同名角色不能自动产生同名 semantic tag。

statement.en: Personality/Design changes access, visibility and mode of carrying the composed meaning. Layer identity cannot by itself create a topic tag or psychological verdict.
statement.zh-Hans: Personality/Design 调节组合意义的进入方式、可见性与承载方式；Layer 身份本身不能创造 topic tag 或心理结论。

statement.en: A semantic tag may be emitted only when an admitted tag-evidence record explicitly links the composed source meaning to that tag. Keyword similarity, label overlap or free LLM interpretation are insufficient.
statement.zh-Hans: 只有存在已 admission 的 tag-evidence record，明确把组合后的来源意义连接到该 tag 时，才允许输出 semantic tag。关键词相似、名称重叠或 LLM 自由解释均不足以成立。

statement.en: Operational composition uses factor-level evidence: 64 Gate Base meanings, 6 Line modifiers, 12 Driver roles and 2 Layer roles. It must not create 384 Gate×Line owner mappings as a disguised direct table.
statement.zh-Hans: 运行组合使用 factor-level evidence：64 个 Gate Base、6 个 Line modifier、12 个 Driver role 与 2 个 Layer role；不得建立 384 个 Gate×Line owner mapping 作为伪装的直接映射表。

statement.en: Multiple admitted tags may coexist. Tag presence does not establish priority, severity, positivity, negativity or Runtime Owner.
statement.zh-Hans: 多个已 admission 的 tag 可以同时存在。Tag 的出现本身不代表优先级、严重程度、正负价值或 Runtime Owner。

statement.en: If admitted factor evidence supports incompatible tag interpretations and no governed precedence resolves the conflict, the disputed tag result remains UNKNOWN.
statement.zh-Hans: 如果已 admission 的 factor evidence 支持彼此冲突的 tag 解释，而没有受治理的优先规则可以解决冲突，则争议 tag 必须保持 UNKNOWN。

statement.en: Gene Keys structural correspondences may contribute admitted interpretation context, but Shadow/Gift/Siddhi labels or sphere names cannot directly become PHI tags, customer verdicts or Runtime Owners.
statement.zh-Hans: Gene Keys 的结构对应可以贡献已 admission 的解释背景，但 Shadow/Gift/Siddhi 标签或 sphere 名称不能直接变成 PHI tags、客户结论或 Runtime Owner。

statement.en: RECOVERY may appear only when the composed evidence supports the accepted Recovery tag definition. It is not inherited from Earth, any planet, or former Chiron material; its semantic authority remains Book IV Part 8 Maintenance Runtime.
statement.zh-Hans: 只有组合证据支持已 ACCEPT 的 RECOVERY 定义时才允许出现 RECOVERY。它不能从 Earth、任何行星或旧 Chiron 内容继承；其语义 authority 继续属于第四册 Part 8 Maintenance Runtime。

statement.en: R7-W4 produces governed semantic tags only. Runtime Owner selection is a separate R7-W5 step and must consume admitted tag composition rather than raw Gate, Line, Driver, Layer or external labels.
statement.zh-Hans: R7-W4 只产生受治理的 semantic tags。Runtime Owner 选择属于独立的 R7-W5，并且必须读取已 admission 的 tag composition，而不能直接读取 Gate、Line、Driver、Layer 或外部标签。
